audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Levite-city and refuge-city law tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for forty-eight Levite cities, pasture measurements, six refuge cities, unintentional versus intentional killing, blood-avenger boundaries, congregational judgment, high-priest death, witness requirements, ransom prohibition, and land-blood theology. Strong due-process and anti-death-penalty safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses in plains of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

modern.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Command children of Israel that they give to Levites from inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in, and pastureland around cities you shall give to Levites.

familiar.text: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

modern.text: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.

original.text: צַו֮ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ לַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרָ֗שׁ לֶֽעָרִים֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: Cities shall be for them to dwell in, and their pasturelands shall be for their cattle, their property, and all their animals.

familiar.text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

modern.text: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.

original.text: וְהָי֧וּ הֶֽעָרִ֛ים לָהֶ֖ם לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם֙ וְלִרְכֻשָׁ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽם

verses.restored: Pasturelands of cities that you give to Levites shall be from wall of city outward one thousand cubits around.

familiar.text: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

modern.text: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.

original.text: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִקִּ֤יר הָעִיר֙ וָח֔וּצָה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: You shall measure outside city on east side two thousand cubits, south side two thousand cubits, west side two thousand cubits, and north side two thousand cubits, with city in midst; this shall be for them pasturelands of cities.

familiar.text: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

modern.text: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.

original.text: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת פְּאַת קֵ֣דְמָה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה וְאֶת פְּאַת יָ֣ם אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ זֶ֚ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם מִגְרְשֵׁ֖י הֶעָרִֽים

verses.restored: Cities that you give to Levites shall include six cities of refuge, which you shall give for manslayer to flee there; and besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

familiar.text: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

modern.text: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.

original.text: וְאֵ֣ת הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֵ֚ת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ לָנֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּה הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתְּנ֔וּ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם עִֽיר

verses.restored: All cities you shall give to Levites shall be forty-eight cities, them and their pasturelands.

familiar.text: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

modern.text: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.

original.text: כָּל הֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן וְאֶת מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן

verses.restored: Cities you give from possession of children of Israel: from many you shall take many and from few you shall take few; each according to inheritance that it inherits shall give from its cities to Levites.

familiar.text: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

modern.text: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.” Six Cities of Refuge (Deuteronomy 4:41–43; Deuteronomy 19:1–14; Joshua 20:1–9)

original.text: וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֤ת הָרַב֙ תַּרְבּ֔וּ וּמֵאֵ֥ת הַמְעַ֖ט תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ אִ֗ישׁ כְּפִ֤י נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ יִתֵּ֥ן מֵעָרָ֖יו לַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: When you cross Jordan into land of Canaan,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן

verses.restored: you shall designate for yourselves cities, cities of refuge shall they be for you, and a manslayer who strikes a soul/life unintentionally may flee there.

familiar.text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

modern.text: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.

original.text: וְהִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָכֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָכֶ֑ם וְנָ֥ס שָׁ֨מָּה֙ רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה

verses.restored: Cities shall be for you as refuge from blood-avenger, so manslayer does not die until he stands before congregation for judgment.

familiar.text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

modern.text: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.

original.text: וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֧ם הֶעָרִ֛ים לְמִקְלָ֖ט מִגֹּאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ עַד עָמְד֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: Cities that you give shall be six cities of refuge for you.

familiar.text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

modern.text: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.

original.text: וְהֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑נוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Three cities you shall give across Jordan and three cities you shall give in land of Canaan; cities of refuge they shall be.

familiar.text: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

modern.text: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.

original.text: אֵ֣ת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְאֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶֽינָה

verses.restored: For children of Israel, for sojourner, and for resident settler in their midst these six cities shall be refuge, for everyone who strikes a soul/life unintentionally to flee there.

familiar.text: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

modern.text: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.

original.text: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֤ר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לְמִקְלָ֑ט לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה

verses.restored: But if with instrument of iron he struck him and he died, a murderer he is; murderer shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

modern.text: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

original.text: וְאִם בִּכְלִ֨י בַרְזֶ֧ל הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ

verses.restored: If with stone in hand by which one could die he struck him and he died, a murderer he is; murderer shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

modern.text: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

original.text: וְאִ֡ם בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ

verses.restored: Or if with instrument of wood in hand by which one could die he struck him and he died, a murderer he is; murderer shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

modern.text: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

original.text: א֡וֹ בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר יָמ֨וּת בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָרֹצֵֽחַ

verses.restored: Blood-avenger himself shall put murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.

familiar.text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

modern.text: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.

original.text: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יָמִ֖ית אֶת הָרֹצֵ֑חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ ב֖וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִיתֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: If in hatred he pushes him or throws at him while lying in wait, and he dies,

familiar.text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

modern.text: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,

original.text: וְאִם בְּשִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדָּפֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו בִּצְדִיָּ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת

verses.restored: or in enmity strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck shall surely be put to death; a murderer he is. Blood-avenger shall put murderer to death when he meets him.

familiar.text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

modern.text: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.

original.text: א֣וֹ בְאֵיבָ֞ה הִכָּ֤הוּ בְיָדוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת מֽוֹת יוּמַ֥ת הַמַּכֶּ֖ה רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֗ם יָמִ֛ית אֶת הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּפִגְעוֹ בֽוֹ

verses.restored: But if suddenly without enmity he pushed him, or threw any object upon him without lying in wait,

familiar.text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

modern.text: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,

original.text: וְאִם בְּפֶ֥תַע בְּלֹא אֵיבָ֖ה הֲדָפ֑וֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו כָּל כְּלִ֖י בְּלֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה

verses.restored: or with any stone by which one could die, without seeing, caused it to fall upon him and he died, though he was not his enemy and did not seek his harm,

familiar.text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

modern.text: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,

original.text: א֣וֹ בְכָל אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַיַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖יו וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהוּא֙ לֹא אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: then congregation shall judge between one who struck and blood-avenger according to these judgments.

familiar.text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

modern.text: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

original.text: וְשָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַמַּכֶּ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Congregation shall rescue manslayer from hand of blood-avenger, and congregation shall return him to city of refuge to which he fled; he shall dwell in it until death of high priest who was anointed with holy oil.

familiar.text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

modern.text: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

original.text: וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּה וְיָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗הּ עַד מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: But if manslayer goes out at all beyond border of his city of refuge to which he fled,

familiar.text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

modern.text: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled

original.text: וְאִם יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א הָרֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: and blood-avenger finds him outside border of his city of refuge, and blood-avenger kills manslayer, there is no bloodguilt for him.

familiar.text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

modern.text: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed

original.text: וּמָצָ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם מִח֕וּץ לִגְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ וְרָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אֶת הָ֣רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּֽם

verses.restored: For in his city of refuge he shall dwell until death of high priest; after death of high priest manslayer may return to land of his possession.

familiar.text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

modern.text: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.

original.text: כִּ֣י בְעִ֤יר מִקְלָטוֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֑ל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: These shall be for you as statute of judgment throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

familiar.text: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

modern.text: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.

original.text: וְהָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Everyone striking a soul/life: by mouth of witnesses murderer shall be put to death; but one witness shall not answer against a soul/life for death.

familiar.text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

modern.text: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.

original.text: כָּל מַ֨כֵּה נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְפִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת הָרֹצֵ֑חַ וְעֵ֣ד אֶחָ֔ד לֹא יַעֲנֶ֥ה בְנֶ֖פֶשׁ לָמֽוּת

verses.restored: You shall not take ransom for soul/life of murderer who is guilty to die, but he shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

modern.text: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.

original.text: וְלֹֽא תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֨פֶר֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָמ֑וּת כִּי מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: You shall not take ransom for one who fled to his city of refuge, to return to dwell in land before death of priest.

familiar.text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

modern.text: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

original.text: וְלֹא תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָנ֖וּס אֶל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ לָשׁוּב֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַד מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: You shall not pollute land where you are, for blood pollutes land; and for land no atonement/covering can be made for blood shed in it except by blood of one who shed it.

familiar.text: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

modern.text: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

original.text: וְלֹֽא תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔הּ כִּ֣י הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלָאָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַדָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּ֔הּ כִּי אִ֖ם בְּדַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall not defile land in which you dwell, in whose midst I dwell; for I YHWH dwell in midst of children of Israel.

familiar.text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

modern.text: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”

original.text: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

translation_notes: Cities of refuge interrupt immediate blood vengeance and require communal judgment before death can occur.
The asylum system is open to Israelite, sojourner, and resident settler alike.
The law distinguishes intent, hatred, ambush, weapon, accident, and prior relationship; this is an ancient due-process development rather than permission for impulsive retaliation.
One witness is insufficient for a death sentence, preserving a crucial evidentiary boundary.
Residence until the high priest's death is protective exile but also a major restriction on an unintentional killer and requires legal-history critique.
The blood-avenger and execution provisions are source-preserved ancient law and must not authorize private vengeance, capital punishment, or modern vigilantism.
Verse 33's blood-atonement claim must not be used to demand executions; modern justice can protect life through due process, prevention, accountability, and nonlethal means.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 35 to justify capital punishment, honor revenge, family vengeance, vigilantism, or killing outside lawful process. Its enduring ethical movement is away from immediate retaliation and toward refuge, evidence, intent analysis, equal access, communal judgment, and protection of life.
